question: What is the average total amount paid per order, across all orders that have payments?
sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.order_id,
        SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_paid
    FROM payments p
    JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
    GROUP BY p.order_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_paid) AS avg_total_paid_per_order
FROM order_totals
plan: - Identify each order that appears in the payments table (inner join with orders to ensure valid orders). - For each order, sum payment_value across all its payment rows to get the total amount paid per order. - Compute the average of these order totals across all such orders. - No additional filters beyond requiring a payment record. - Use orders.order_id and payments.payment_value columns. - Return a single numeric value representing the average total paid per order.
